factors: Ten source chapters and eight claims across demonstrated UI, vendor documentation, creator self-report and GhostMesh pilot hypothesis.
Consequence of overlapping task schedulers and remote execution authority demands a detailed adoption boundary.
complexity.rationale: The source is short but packs many distinct coding workflow mechanisms and potential architecture consequences; the Deep treatment maps each class without claiming outcome proof.

sourceMap.rationale: Orca runs Claude and Codex CLI sessions in one terminal-centered interface
Design Mode transmits selected DOM, CSS and screenshot context to agents
Cross-provider orchestration allocates work and improves results
Previous terminal setup reported completion while background work continued

sourceCoverage.rationale: Selected CLI, worktree, browser, Git, orchestration and mobile cues were inspected; the 06:12 source correction removes a false scheduling/SSH attribution.

supportingArgument.rationale: A unified terminal-centered cockpit can reduce switching without replacing the underlying agent executors or claiming an independently verified advantage.

evidenceRoles.rationale: Direct demonstrations, creator opinion, first-party docs and untested GhostMesh hypothesis are explicitly separated in prose and claim metadata.

counterargument.rationale: A polished session list can still misstate child-command completion, while worktrees do not isolate credentials or host authority.

tradeoffs.rationale: Integrated review and browser annotation simplify handoff at the cost of another product dependency and potentially broader captured UI data.

falsifiability.rationale: A disposable multi-provider test measures reviewed-change time, interruptions, owner attention and duplicated task authority; failure rejects the dependency.

originalSynthesis.rationale: GhostMesh can borrow the cockpit while preserving Pale Horse authority, syscall execution and Control Tower receipts as independent control truth.

performance.rationale: The presenter demonstrates operations rather than a controlled workload comparison; no accepted-code throughput claim is made.

economics.rationale: Pilot compares total operator and integration cost without inventing subscription or performance estimates.

threatGovernance.rationale: Browser capture, copied environment files, SSH hosts, mobile relay and autonomous scheduling create boundaries to qualify before privileged use.

gaps.rationale: Video moments were checked using automatic English captions and private source aids, not continuous audiovisual playback; navigation remains a qualified aid.
Vendor documentation describes product mechanisms but does not independently verify reliability, security or productivity.
No bounded Orca versus existing GhostMesh cockpit pilot was run; reduction in owner interventions is a proposed test outcome.

decisionRationale: Independent source/copy/privacy review accepted corrected article for Tony's authenticated exact-content GitHub marker and separate release decision. No runtime adoption implied.
